items.name: Large Metal Garage - foundation
items.description: Create a low-poly all metal garage with light gray aluminum corigated siding and a black standing seem roof.  Create it in 4 stages and keep all previous  stages in the next stage.  1) concrete foundations with  6" stem walls 2) Metal Framing 3) siding (no roof) 4) completed garage. (foundation growth stage)
